title: Your First MCP Server in Python: Tools, Resources and Inspector
summary: Karim Lalani walks through building a first MCP server in Python and using it in Claude Desktop.

chapters.title: Calling an LLM from an MCP Tool

learn: The lab builds a simple Greeter server whose one tool returns a Texas greeting.
MCP servers advertise tools, resources and prompts; the Python SDK publishes a tool's docstring as its description, which becomes context for the language model.
MCP Inspector lets you introspect and test your server without an LLM, so you do not burn tokens while developing.
You run it with uv, and the SDK has a command to install the server into Claude Desktop, which he says works on a Mac.
An MCP tool can reach outside the LLM, even call another LLM: his ComfyUI MCP server has an LLM write the image prompt.
